تستصبحون (form X)
# تَسْتَصْبِحُونَ (tastaṣbiḥūna) /tas.tasˤ.bi.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَصْبَحَ (istaṣbaḥa)
# تُسْتَصْبَحُونَ (tustaṣbaḥūna) /tus.tasˤ.ba.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَصْبَحَ (istaṣbaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
